methodology: Sample 5 gaps per format (FODT, XCF, FODS, DIF, FODG). For each gap, grep tests/python/{format}/ for the capability name. VERIFIED = at least 1 test file matches. CLAIMED_UNPROVEN = no test file found.
finding: Gaps are bulk-closed. 17/25 sampled gaps have indirect test evidence (function name match), 8/25 have no identifiable test. The bulk-closure methodology cannot be considered per-gap verified evidence. TC-GUARD-001 gap_ledger_ref citations to these gaps should be treated as CLAIMED_UNPROVEN until per-gap test names are explicitly linked.
